posts.t: Yurov on the top PP unit with Shabanov out tonight.

FINAL: Wild 2, Blue Jackets 1

SOG: 34-14, Wild 

Kaprizov with his 10th goal of the season, on the power play. Yurov scores his fourth of the season.

Wild take a 1-0 lead with 1:47 left in the first period. 

Yakov Trenin with the slick feed to Danila Yurov.
